ActorUrl.description:
Canonical actor ID URL (the ActivityPub `id` of the actor, `https`), the same
identity as Emumet `ProfileActorRef.actor_url`. It is NOT an acct/handle:
converting a UI `from:@user` into this URL is the BFF/UI responsibility.

ApiStatus.description: Body of the example contract route.

BlockingDomainControlRef.description:
The blocking E8 policy snapshot. Changing this requires an explicit Emumet
domain-controls update; a post operation or reveal never unblocks implicitly.

revision.description: The same E8 int64 monotonic revision, never minted by ShuttlePub.

ContentNotificationsResponse.description:
Only visible notifications contribute to unread_count. No hidden marker,
count, explanation or push/history recall guarantee is exposed here.

ContentPageInfo.description:
S8 collection cursor only. Closed metadata prevents hidden-count/annotation
extensions; opaque cursors must not disclose suppressed identities or counts.

ContentRestriction.description:
Independent content gates. Reveal does not clear CW/sensitive, deletion or
viewing permission. A restricted response carries no gated content.

ControlDomain.description:
E8 DomainControlResponse.domain, not a second normalizer. Already normalized
lowercase ASCII/IDNA A-label host; UTS #46 non-transitional; remove one trailing
dot. Exact match: example.com does not include sub.example.com. E8 rejects
invalid inputs with 422. Match only Emumet D8P ControlDomain::from_actor_id's
verified canonical actor-ID host, never display acct, username or asserted domain.

DirectItem.description:
Explicitly revealed item. Boost-wrapper direct reveal is undecided and not
part of S8 (the original note URL uses ordinary single-note reveal).
A revealed quote carries its directly quoted target too (one reveal shows
the whole quote). Operations concern the revealed note's own author, NOT the
domain of its embedded quote target. The unblocked quoter remains actionable.

DirectNoteResponse.description:
Profile scoped direct view. Initial GET is hidden for a controlled domain.
POST reveal is explicit and applies only to this note and, for a quote, its
directly quoted target, in the current page. Never persist or sync reveal,
never change E8 revision. Hide discards the page-local result; reload/revisit
uses GET and hides again. Reveal never changes another note, a nested quote,
block, CW/sensitive or viewing rights.

DomainBlockMode.description: Block-only projection of E8 mode; not an additional policy mode.

DomainControlMode.description:
E8 DomainControlMode, verbatim: mute suppresses display only; block also
refuses new operations in both directions. Never a new ShuttlePub setting.

DomainControlRef.description:
Immutable observation of E8 DomainControlResponse, not a local policy copy.
No created_at/updated_at needed for content presentation.

profile_id.description:
E8 profile_id (Profile nanoid); same value as path profile_nanoid and
ProfileResponse.id. Never Account ID, actor URL or nullable username.

revision.description:
E8 int64 revision, starts at 1. Create/replace/delete/recreate advance it;
tombstones prevent reuse. Not S3 settings revision or a reveal revision.

DomainOperationPermission.description:
Domain-only operation permission; allowed does not bypass D13 or any other
permission. Mute adds no operation restriction. Block is not cleared by reveal.

EmbeddedNotePresentation.description:
The directly quoted target of a revealed quote, and only that one target.
It has NO hidden variant: a domain-controlled quoted target is hidden together
with its quote (see [`HiddenCause::Quote`]), and the single explicit reveal of
the quote resolves both. After reveal the target is `visible` unless an
independent gate (CW, sensitive, deletion, viewing rights) keeps it
`restricted`, content-free. No decision about attribution through nested
quotes (the target quoting yet another note) is made.

EmojiAvailability.description: Whether an emoji can currently be used.

EmojiImageState.description:
Whether the image of a custom emoji can be shown. Independent of
[`EmojiAvailability`].

emoji.description:
Identity of the chip's emoji. Two chips are the same chip exactly when
their `emoji` are equal.

oneOf.description:
Display data of the chip's emoji (D09). The server always sends it for
a custom emoji chip, so `view.origin` tells the UI, per chip, whether the
emoji is external (globe mark) and tells same-named emoji of different
servers apart; `view.emoji` equals `emoji`. A Unicode chip may omit it.

EmojiReactionDomainBlock.description:
Per-operation emoji_reaction block refusal details. Explicit unblock in Emumet is
required first; mute never produces this result. D13 cannot override block.

EmojiReactionOperation.description: Operation identity, distinct on the wire from every other post action.

EmojiRef.description:
Identity of an emoji. Two references are the same emoji when they are equal
as JSON values, which is why this type carries no display data.

oneOf.description: A Unicode emoji, identified by its code point sequence.

value.description:
The fully qualified emoji sequence, for example `👍` or `👨‍👩‍👧‍👦`.
At most 32 code points, no Unicode White_Space or control characters
and at least one non-ASCII code point; the pattern spells out exactly
the characters the server rejects (the exact emoji set is checked by
the server; skin tones and ZWJ sequences are distinct emoji).

oneOf.description:
A custom emoji, identified by the server's stable emoji identifier.
The identifier survives deletion, so an unavailable emoji keeps its
identity.

id.description: Stable identifier of the custom emoji (not the shortcode).

EmojiUsage.description: Where a custom emoji may be used.

EmojiView.description: An emoji as returned by the server: identity plus availability and display data.

availability.description: Current availability. Unicode emoji are always `available`.

oneOf.description:
Whether the image can be shown; independent of `availability`. Present
for custom emoji, absent for Unicode emoji. `present` goes with
`image_url`, `missing` means show `:shortcode:`.

image_url.description:
Image of a custom emoji when one is still served; absent for Unicode
emoji and for deleted custom emoji.

oneOf.description:
Originating domain of an external custom emoji (same canonical host
form as the E8 domain controls). Absent for Unicode emoji and for custom
emoji of this server, so its presence is the external mark (globe).

shortcode.description: Display shortcode of a custom emoji, without colons; absent for Unicode emoji.

oneOf.description:
Where the emoji may be used. Present for custom emoji (an external one
is `existing_reaction_only`); absent means `anywhere` (Unicode emoji).

ErrorBody.description:
Structured error body returned by `/api/v1` handlers for every error they report.

Responses produced by the framework itself (unmatched route, wrong method)
do not go through a handler and therefore do not use this body.

code.description: Stable machine readable code; clients should branch on this value.

oneOf.description:
Optional S8 outbound block refusal. code remains forbidden (403); absent
for all existing S0/S3 errors. No mutation, implicit unblock or Undo.

message.description: Human readable description intended for developers, not end users.

ErrorCode.description: Machine readable error code carried by every error body.

FeedItem.description:
A feed contains only visible items. For mute AND block, omit an entire
third-party quote (including the quoter's comment) or pure repost when its
immediate target is suppressed. Do not mute/block that third party or their
unrelated posts. No hidden variant, placeholder, suppressed count or note.

FieldViolation.description: A single field level validation problem.

field.description: Name or JSON pointer of the offending field.

HiddenCause.description:
Why a note is hidden on direct open (D08 ui-spec 3-1 / 3-4).

- `direct`: the note's own author is in the controlled domain. The UI says
  the note is from a muted/blocked domain.
- `quote`: the note's own author is NOT controlled, but the note directly
  quotes a note of a controlled domain. The UI says the note quotes a
  muted/blocked domain's post and names that domain (the quoted source).

When both apply the cause is `direct` and the domain is the note's own
author's; the single reveal resolves both. A quote whose directly quoted
target is deleted or not viewable by the caller is never `quote`: that would
disclose the domain of a note the caller cannot see, so the target is
`restricted` instead. Only the immediate quote target is considered; nested
quotes are unspecified.

InboundEmojiReactionRejection.description:
ShuttlePub INTERNAL inbound emoji_reaction acceptance result contract, NOT a wire
inbox/API or an ActivityPub HTTP status. Refuse NEW actions from this domain
to this Profile, even if D13 permits the action. No rejection on mute alone.

InboundLikeRejection.description:
ShuttlePub INTERNAL inbound like acceptance result contract, NOT a wire
inbox/API or an ActivityPub HTTP status. Refuse NEW actions from this domain
to this Profile, even if D13 permits the action. No rejection on mute alone.

InboundQuoteRejection.description:
ShuttlePub INTERNAL inbound quote acceptance result contract, NOT a wire
inbox/API or an ActivityPub HTTP status. Refuse NEW actions from this domain
to this Profile, even if D13 permits the action. No rejection on mute alone.

InboundReplyRejection.description:
ShuttlePub INTERNAL inbound reply acceptance result contract, NOT a wire
inbox/API or an ActivityPub HTTP status. Refuse NEW actions from this domain
to this Profile, even if D13 permits the action. No rejection on mute alone.

InboundRepostRejection.description:
ShuttlePub INTERNAL inbound repost acceptance result contract, NOT a wire
inbox/API or an ActivityPub HTTP status. Refuse NEW actions from this domain
to this Profile, even if D13 permits the action. No rejection on mute alone.

LikeDomainBlock.description:
Per-operation like block refusal details. Explicit unblock in Emumet is
required first; mute never produces this result. D13 cannot override block.

LikeOperation.description: Operation identity, distinct on the wire from every other post action.

NoteContent.description: Minimal content projection for this contract, not a full author/media DTO.

NotePresentation.description:
Direct URL presentation. Hidden contains ONLY state, cause, E8 mode, domain
and revision: no body, author details, media, CW text, mention, note id or
embedded/quoted data (not even the quoted author). `mode`, `domain` and
`revision` are those of the E8 control that caused the hiding: the note's own
author domain for `direct`, the quoted source's domain for `quote`.
Restricted remains content-free even after an explicit single-note reveal.

revision.description: E8 revision, not a session/reveal token.

NoteSearchItem.description:
Search result item. Only an author's own post, reply or quote WITH a comment
exist; a pure repost (no comment) is not representable at all.

NoteSearchPageInfo.description:
Paging metadata of a search page. Closed: no total, hidden count or
suppression note can be added. `truncated` reports only that the response
time limit stopped the scan early; it says nothing about suppressed items.

Generated as a `oneOf` on the `truncated` literal (see `ContractFixups`):
`truncated: true` REQUIRES a non-empty string `next_cursor`; `truncated:
false` may omit it. A cursor is never `null` and never the empty string, and
deserialization rejects the same cases.

next_cursor.description:
Resume point, a non-empty opaque string. Present when a further match is
known at evaluation time OR when `truncated` is true (then it resumes after
the last scanned position, so no match is skipped). Absent only when the
scan reached the end of the matching range. A following page may still be
empty.

truncated.description:
True when the response time limit stopped the scan before the page was
full or the range ended. The items are then exactly the matches before
the resume point (an exact prefix, no gaps, possibly none) and
`next_cursor` is always present and non-empty. A UI shows "interrupted
here", stops automatic loading, and may resume only on an explicit action
with `next_cursor`, which starts a fresh time budget.

next_cursor.description:
Resume point, a non-empty opaque string. Present when a further match is
known at evaluation time OR when `truncated` is true (then it resumes after
the last scanned position, so no match is skipped). Absent only when the
scan reached the end of the matching range. A following page may still be
empty.

truncated.description:
True when the response time limit stopped the scan before the page was
full or the range ended. The items are then exactly the matches before
the resume point (an exact prefix, no gaps, possibly none) and
`next_cursor` is always present and non-empty. A UI shows "interrupted
here", stops automatic loading, and may resume only on an explicit action
with `next_cursor`, which starts a fresh time budget.

NoteSearchResponse.description:
Note search page: only notes the Profile may view, newest first. There is no
total, hidden count, suppression note or placeholder. Mute/block suppression
(S8) leaves no trace. Each page is evaluated against the latest state (no
snapshot): an edit, deletion, lost view right or newly added mute/block takes
effect on the next page, nothing already returned is retracted, and a note is
never returned twice. When the time limit is reached after resumable progress
the page is a partial 200 with `page.truncated = true`; `503 search_timeout`
is only for a timeout without any such progress.

PageInfo.description: Pagination metadata embedded in collection responses.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page; absent on the last page.

PageParams.description: Query parameters for cursor paginated collections.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor taken from a previous `next_cursor`.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return; the server picks a default when omitted.

PostComment.description: Reply/quote input only; success-creation semantics are outside S8.

ProfileNanoid.description: Public identifier of a posting Profile (Emumet's `profile_nanoid`).

PutReaction.description: Request body selecting the reaction of a Profile on a Note.

emoji.description:
The emoji to select; replaces any previous selection, except that an
external emoji (`usage: existing_reaction_only`) never replaces: it is
refused with `409` while another reaction is selected.

QuickReactionSettings.description: Quick reaction settings of a Profile.

favorites.description: Ordered favourites, at most 5 and pairwise distinct by `emoji`. Unavailable favourites are kept and flagged, never removed silently.

revision.description:
Monotonic revision, `0` for a Profile that never saved settings. It
increases by one whenever the stored favourites change.

QuoteDomainBlock.description:
Per-operation quote block refusal details. Explicit unblock in Emumet is
required first; mute never produces this result. D13 cannot override block.

QuoteOperation.description: Operation identity, distinct on the wire from every other post action.

ReactionCounts.description:
Accepted historical likes/emoji remain counted after block; rejected new
operations add nothing. No automatic deletion or Undo, no block annotation.
Independent legitimate removal can still change counts.

ReactionState.description: The reaction a Profile has on a Note.

oneOf.description:
The selected emoji, or `null` when the Profile has not reacted. The
emoji may be `unavailable`, or external (`origin` set); it can still be
removed.

note_id.description: The Note the reaction belongs to.

RejectedOutcome.description: Internal acceptance decision, not an ActivityPub inbox wire response.

ReplyDomainBlock.description:
Per-operation reply block refusal details. Explicit unblock in Emumet is
required first; mute never produces this result. D13 cannot override block.

ReplyOperation.description: Operation identity, distinct on the wire from every other post action.

RepostDomainBlock.description:
Per-operation repost block refusal details. Explicit unblock in Emumet is
required first; mute never produces this result. D13 cannot override block.

RepostOperation.description: Operation identity, distinct on the wire from every other post action.

ResolveAuthorResponse.description:
Answer of `resolveNoteSearchAuthor`: the one author the acct designates.

`Cache-Control: private, no-store` applies (the answer depends on the viewing Profile).

RevisionConflictBody.description:
`409` body for a stale `expected_revision`: the common `ErrorBody` fields
with `code` fixed to `revision_conflict`, plus the stored revision.

current_revision.description: The revision currently stored; refetch the settings and retry.

message.description: Human readable description intended for developers, not end users.

SearchAuthor.description:
One author of a lookup result. Closed: it carries no inbox, public key, Account
ID, relationship state (follow / mute / block), fetch origin or cache time.

acct.description:
`user@host` without a leading `@`. An author of this server carries this server's
own host. In a resolve answer it is the confirmed or verified acct; in a suggestion
it is the acct shown for the author, which for a remote author may be derived for
display only and therefore need not resolve. A chosen candidate is identified by
`actor_url`, never by resolving this text again.

actor_url.description:
Canonical actor ID URL, the same type and constraints as the `author` of
`searchPersonalNotes` (`ActorUrl`): a result can be passed straight to it.

display_name.description: Display name as stored, or `null` when the author has none. The key is always present.

icon_url.description:
Avatar URL (https) as stored, or `null`. The key is always present. A browser that
loads a remote icon directly reveals its IP address to that server: how icons are
fetched or proxied is the frontends' image policy, not part of this contract.

SearchNoteBody.description:
What a search result shows of a note. A content-warned note exposes its CW
only and can never carry the body, even when only the body matched the query
(the UI keeps it folded). The two variants are closed and exclusive.

SearchedNote.description: One matched note of its author. No quoted/replied-to content is included.

author.description: Canonical actor ID URL of the note's author.

created_at.description:
RFC 3339 UTC creation time. Results are ordered by the instant it denotes
(fractional seconds and offsets are compared as time values, never as
text), newest first, then by `note_id` descending (lowercase hyphenated
UUID text order). An edit never changes it.

SuggestAuthorsResponse.description:
Answer of `suggestNoteSearchAuthors`: up to five candidates, best first. No paging,
no total, no hidden count. Never contains an author the Profile mutes or blocks
(individually or by domain), and no actor URL twice. An empty `items` is an ordinary
`200` (nothing matches), never a stand-in for an error.

`Cache-Control: private, no-store` applies (the answer depends on the viewing Profile).

TimelineResponse.description: Profile-scoped timeline: suppressed items leave no trace, including counts.

UpdateQuickReactionSettings.description: Request body replacing the favourites of a Profile.

expected_revision.description: The revision the client last saw. Use `0` for the first save.

favorites.description: The complete new ordered list: 0..=5 pairwise distinct emoji. An empty list clears the favourites.

bearer_auth.description: Bearer access token of the signed-in user. The caller must be allowed to act as the Profile in the path.

info.description: ShuttlePub /api/v1 contract. Routes and types only: handlers are stubs answering 501 until the backend is implemented.
info.title: ShuttlePub API

get.description:
Author and keyword are both optional but not both absent; an author-less
keyword search is part of the standard (engine-less) configuration, bounded
by `limit`, the `q` length and a response time limit: reaching it with
resumable progress yields a partial 200 (`page.truncated`), without any
progress `503 search_timeout`.
Notes are the author's own posts, replies and quotes with a comment; pure
reposts are not searchable. Contract only: no real filtering, enforcement or
posting. Always 501.

parameters.description:
Single author as a canonical actor ID URL (never an acct). Optional: when
omitted the search covers every note the Profile may view. An author the
server has not fetched is `404 not_found` (`details.field = author`); an
author whose domain this Profile mutes/blocks is an ordinary empty `200`.
parameters.name: author

parameters.description:
Literal substring matched against a note's body AND its content warning
(never the quoted/replied-to note's text). `%`, `_` and backslash have no
special meaning. Optional (author-only search lists that author's notes).
UNDECIDED, not fixed by this contract: case-insensitive matching and
whether whitespace-separated words are ANDed; clients must not rely on either.
parameters.name: q

parameters.description:
Opaque cursor from a previous `next_cursor`. It is bound to the Profile,
`author` and `q` it was issued for; another condition or a malformed value
is `400 invalid_request` (`details.field = cursor`).
parameters.name: cursor

200.description: Future contract response, never returned by the stub

400.description: invalid_request: neither author nor q, empty or over-long q, limit out of range, author not an actor ID URL, or a cursor that is malformed or issued for another Profile/author/q (details.field names the parameter)

403.description: Caller cannot act as this Profile; domain controls suppress items rather than deny the collection.

404.description: not_found: the Profile, or an author actor this server has not fetched (details.field = author). A suppressed domain is never a 404.

501.description: Contract only; always returned until implemented

503.description: search_timeout: the response time limit was exceeded before any resumable progress, so there is nothing consistent to return (a timeout WITH progress is a partial 200 with page.truncated = true). Narrowing with author may succeed.

delete.description:
Idempotent and independent of emoji availability: answers `200` with
`emoji: null` also when nothing was selected, and also when the selected
emoji has become unavailable.

200.description: Unreacted state (emoji null), including a repeated delete. Contract only: never returned while the endpoint is a stub

403.description: The caller may not act as this Profile (forbidden)

404.description: Unknown Profile or Note (not_found); never because no reaction exists

delete.summary: Remove the reaction of a Profile on a Note (stub: always answers 501)

200.description: Selected emoji, or emoji null when not reacted. Contract only: never returned while the endpoint is a stub

403.description: The caller may not act as this Profile (forbidden)

get.summary: Get the reaction of a Profile on a Note (stub: always answers 501)

put.description:
Idempotent: repeating the same emoji returns `200` with the same state. A
different emoji replaces the previous one (1 Profile, 1 Note, 1 reaction),
except for external emoji (`usage: existing_reaction_only`, see the module
docs). Rules, first match answers: 1 an unavailable emoji is `422
emoji_unavailable`, even when it is the emoji already selected (the
selection then stays and can be removed with `DELETE`); 2 the emoji equals
the current selection: `200` no-op; 3 external emoji without a chip of the
same emoji on the Note: `422 emoji_usage_not_allowed`; 4 external emoji while
the Profile reacted with another emoji: `409 conflict` (no direct
replacement, the current reaction stays); 5 select: `200`.

200.description: State after selecting (also for a repeated or replacing request). Contract only: never returned while the endpoint is a stub

400.description: Malformed emoji identifier or profile_nanoid (invalid_request with details)

403.description: Forbidden: caller may not act as Profile, or E8 domain block refuses the new emoji operation. Block uses optional ErrorBody.domain_block (EmojiReactionDomainBlock); explicit unblock required first. Mute adds no restriction. Existing S3 error shape remains valid.

409.description: An external emoji (usage existing_reaction_only) was requested while the Profile already reacted with another emoji (conflict); the current reaction stays, DELETE it first

422.description: The emoji is unavailable (emoji_unavailable, checked before the repeat no-op rule), or an external emoji has no chip on the Note (emoji_usage_not_allowed, checked after it); the current reaction stays

put.summary: Select the reaction of a Profile on a Note (stub: always answers 501)

put.description:
Full replacement guarded by `expected_revision`. Idempotent retry: when
`favorites` equal the stored list the stored settings are returned with
`200` and the revision is unchanged, whatever `expected_revision` is.
Otherwise a revision mismatch is `409 revision_conflict`.

200.description: Stored settings after the update (new revision), or unchanged settings for an idempotent retry. Contract only: never returned while the endpoint is a stub

400.description: More than 5 favorites, duplicates, malformed emoji identifiers or profile_nanoid (invalid_request with details)

403.description: The caller may not act as this Profile (forbidden)

409.description: expected_revision is stale (revision_conflict); current_revision tells the stored revision

422.description: A newly added emoji is unavailable (emoji_unavailable), or is an external emoji that may not be a favorite (emoji_usage_not_allowed, usage existing_reaction_only); favorites already stored may stay (details point at the offending /favorites/{index}). Unavailable is reported before usage

put.summary: Replace the quick reaction settings of a Profile (stub: always answers 501)

get.description:
The target set is the authors ShuttlePub has already fetched notes of AND the viewing
Profile may publicly refer to. The acct is resolved only through a username this server
has confirmed or a verified remote acct mapping. The server never asks the remote
server: no WebFinger, no actor fetch, synchronous or asynchronous. An acct that cannot
be resolved is `404 not_found` (`details.field = acct`), never a guess; several matching
mappings are `409 conflict`, never the first one. Mute/block does not hide an author
here (the acct was typed explicitly, and the later search follows `searchPersonalNotes`:
an author of a muted or blocked domain gives an ordinary empty 200). Every response
carries `Cache-Control: private, no-store`. Contract only: it never searches. Always 501.

parameters.description:
Exactly one acct typed after `from:@`: `user@host`, `@user@host`, or without a host
`user` / `@user`, which is THIS server's username (a host equal to this server's own
host means the same). One leading `@` is removed; the username is not lowercased and no
host is guessed; the host is normalised to lowercase ASCII (IDNA) and must be a valid
DNS name without port, IP address or trailing dot. At most 512 characters after
normalisation (513 raw). Empty, repeated, whitespace, control or bidi control
characters, URL syntax (`from:` / `acct:` prefixes, actor URLs) and an invalid host are
`400 invalid_request` with `details.field = acct`. It resolves only through a username
this server has confirmed or a verified remote acct mapping, never through an acct
derived for display (`preferred_username` + actor host, not verified by WebFinger).
parameters.name: acct

200.description: Future contract response, never returned by the stub. Cache-Control: private, no-store.

400.description: invalid_request: acct missing, repeated, empty, over-long, containing whitespace, control or bidi control characters or URL syntax, or with an invalid host (details.field = acct)

403.description: forbidden: the caller cannot act as this Profile

404.description: not_found: the Profile, or an acct that is not a fetched author this server can confirm (username unknown here, no verified remote acct mapping; details.field = acct). Never produced by asking the remote server.

get.summary: Resolve one acct to the author it designates (contract only; always 501).

get.description:
At most 5 authors whose display name or acct starts with the prefix, among the authors
ShuttlePub has already fetched notes of AND the viewing Profile may publicly refer to.
Authors the Profile mutes or blocks (individually or by domain) are never candidates.
Emumet's shared display cache is not a source (it would leak fetch history caused by
other Profiles' block/mute), and no external lookup is made, synchronously or
asynchronously. Order: acct equals the prefix, then acct starts with it, then display name
starts with it; ties by normalised acct, then actor URL. One entry per actor URL. No
candidate is `200` with `items: []`. Every response carries
`Cache-Control: private, no-store`. Always 501.

parameters.description:
Exactly one prefix typed after `from:@`, matched against the display name OR the
acct of candidate authors from the front only: no substring, regular expression or
wildcard, and `%` / `_` are literal characters. One leading `@` is removed; 1..=512
characters remain (513 raw); spaces are allowed, control characters are not
(`400 invalid_request`, `details.field = prefix`). Matching alone applies Unicode
normalisation (NFKC) and lowercasing to both sides; returned text keeps its stored form.
parameters.name: prefix

200.description: Future contract response, never returned by the stub. 0..=5 candidates; none is `items: []`. Cache-Control: private, no-store.

400.description: invalid_request: prefix missing, repeated, empty (also after removing the leading @), over-long or containing control characters (details.field = prefix)
